summary: CASI Pharmaceuticals filed a Form 6-K reporting the sale of its equity interests in Alesta Therapeutics B.V. to BioMarin Pharmaceutical Inc., concurrent with BioMarin's acquisition of Alesta. The transaction closed August 31, 2026. CASI received approximately US$5.9 million in net cash proceeds at closing and may receive allocable contingent milestone payments, subject to terms. Alesta spun out non-ALE1 assets pre-closing; CASI's licensed rights to CID-103 remain unchanged. No board recommendation or advisors named. Watch for milestone payment announcements and impact on CASI's CID-103 development.
